widgets_values:
## LTX-2.5 IC-LoRA: a guide video (depth, canny, pose)

[LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5) with an in-context LoRA: the frames of the guide video sit next
to the generated ones, and the IC-LoRA decides what is taken from them. Here the Union Control IC-LoRA of LTX-2.3
(depth, canny or pose maps in one adapter; 2.3 IC-LoRAs mostly load on 2.5) gets the Canny edges of **Guide
video**. Replace **Canny** by a depth or pose preprocessor (comfyui_controlnet_aux) for the other kinds, or
bypass it for a guide that is a map already. Other IC-LoRAs (Layout to Render, Motion Track, Ingredients)
go into **IC-LoRA** the same way.

**Guide**: strength 1.0 (0.5-0.8 leaves more freedom), from frame 0, cut to 8n+1 frames and resized to the
latent (**Get IC-LoRA Parameters** reads the half-resolution guide of `ref0.5` from the LoRA). Make the
guide at least as long as **Length (frames)** and at the video's frame rate. Describe the look in the prompt,
not the motion: the motion comes from the guide. The guide applies in stage 1 only.

**Guide video** is `ib:vref:0`: add the video in the References panel of the Generate tab (also by dragging a
video card from Generated); the group is bypassed while there is none, and the panel warns when the guide has
fewer frames than **Length (frames)**.

**Settings** (distilled): stage 1 with 8 fixed sigmas, stage 2 with 3, CFG 1, euler_ancestral. **Width** and
**Height** are the stage 1 size (sides multiples of 32); stage 2 doubles it in latent space (640×352 → 1280×704).
**Length (frames)** is 8n+1 (121 ≈ 5 s at 24 fps, up to about 10 s per shot), **Frame rate** feeds the
conditioning, the audio latent and the video.

## Image Bench

| Marker | Node | Generate tab |
|--------|------|--------------|
| `ib:cp` | Load Diffusion Model | model list |
| `ib:pp` | Image Bench Prompt | prompt and LoRA list |
| `ib:smp` | Stage 1 sampler | seed (RandomNoise), sampling method (KSamplerSelect), size (Empty LTXV Latent Video) |
| `ib:smp:1` | Stage 2 sampler | Hires. fix group |
| `ib:hr` | Stage 2 (If/Else Switch, video and audio) | Hires. fix checkbox; switched on by the Upscale button |
| `ib:ref:0` | First frame (bypassed) | References panel, first image |
| `ib:ref:1` | Last frame (bypassed) | References panel, second image |
| `ib:vref:0` | Guide video (bypassed) | References panel, video |
| `ib:lora` | Load LoRA (bypassed) | LoRA exploration only |

**Length (frames)** and **Frame rate** are the fields of the Video tab (beside Sampling); Frames keeps 8n+1.

**Hires. fix** is stage 2: off, the stage 1 video at the Generate tab size is saved (a fast draft) and stage 2
does not run; on, it is upscaled 2× and refined. Steps are fixed sigma lists, so the steps fields stay hidden.

**Frames**: the first image of the References panel is the first frame (written into the latent, strength 0.7 in
stage 1, 1.0 in stage 2), the second one the last frame (a guide at frame -1, removed again by **LTXV Crop
Guides** after each stage). An empty slot is bypassed with its nodes.

The negative prompt does nothing at CFG 1 and is not marked. The official templates add a prompt enhancer
(Gemma 4 E2B, **TextGenerateLTX2Prompt**); here the prompt goes to the encoder as written, so write it in
full: subject, action, camera, light, then the sound.

**loras**: [ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Union-Control/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors)
